name: ga4-reporting
description: Reconcile GA4 acquisition and exploration exports into a monthly client report using supplied scopes, attribution settings and quality indicators. Use when GA4 reports and explorations disagree, you need to explain acquisition totals, or you want a monthly analytics report for a client. Works from pasted tables, supplied exports and settings, keeping first-user, session and event credit separate. Produces a reconciliation and a client-ready report with formulas and the quality findings that affect interpretation. Not for tracking installation, campaign optimization, live account access or scheduled monitoring.
